detail: Full summary: the server-startup spawn tests boot dist/index.js against this repo's cwd, so any new canonical gitignore entry lands in this repo's own .twining/.gitignore the first time those tests run after the change — expect a modified .twining/.gitignore after test/server-startup.test.ts, not a stray edit
